chunks.subject: AP English Language
chunks.title: High-band sample (5–6)
chunks.content: PLACEHOLDER — paste a real high-scoring sample response (or a faithful excerpt) for this prompt, or a tight summary of what earns 5–6: defensible thesis analyzing rhetorical choices, well-chosen specific evidence woven into a clear line of reasoning, commentary that consistently explains how choices advance the writer's purpose, and a moment of sophistication.

chunks.subject: AP English Language
chunks.title: Mid-band sample (3–4)
chunks.content: PLACEHOLDER — paste a mid-scoring sample for this prompt, or a summary of what earns 3–4: a defensible thesis, adequate but sometimes general evidence, commentary that explains some choices but leaves gaps, and little or no sophistication.

chunks.subject: AP English Language
chunks.title: Low-band sample (1–2)
chunks.content: PLACEHOLDER — paste a low-scoring sample for this prompt, or a summary of what earns 1–2: thesis missing or only restates the prompt, evidence sparse or summarized rather than analyzed, and commentary that does not connect choices to purpose.
